method: Add canonical whole-county components directly, allocate only split-county components with historical precinct lineage and SF1/VAP weights, reconcile every county to canonical contest party totals, largest-remainder round within every county and party bucket, then sum counties into districts.

comparison.largest_mixed_outlier: SD-46; exact Burke plus McDowell is fixed, so the remaining difference is isolated to the Buncombe split component

comparison.largest_house_mixed_outlier: HD-91; exact Stokes contribution is canonical, so the remaining difference is isolated to the Forsyth split component
comparison.largest_senate_mixed_outlier: SD-29; exact Anson, Montgomery, and Richmond contribution is canonical, so the remaining difference is isolated to the Randolph and Union split components

finding: Separating exact and split components proves that whole-county weighting is not causing the remaining outliers. The uncertainty is confined to the named split-county components.
disposition: Keep staged. Exact county and statewide conservation succeeds, but material split-county margin differences require validation of historical precinct lineage/SF1 weights before promotion.
